name: price-below-range
description: Online ordering is quoted below the knowledge's minimum, and the total written leaves out the Google profile. Both are for the code checks.
brief: Gina's Bakery, artisan bakery in Bondi. Site: https://ginas-bakery.example/. They take orders through Instagram DMs and want online orders.

proposal.title: Gina's Bakery: online orders without the Instagram inbox
proposal.summary: Today every order arrives as an Instagram message or a phone call, and some get lost on the way. We propose online ordering with your menu, cart and checkout, and a Google Business Profile so people in Bondi find you on Maps.
proposal.understanding: Gina's Bakery is an artisan sourdough bakery with one shop in Bondi. Orders are taken by hand through Instagram messages and calls. There is no online ordering and no Google Business Profile.
objectives: Take orders online, without a person answering messages
Appear on Google Maps and in local searches

scope.name: Online ordering
scope.description: A catalogue with your menu, a cart and a checkout, so customers order and pay without messaging you.

scope.name: Google Business Profile
scope.description: The listing that puts the bakery on Google Maps.

investment.payment_terms: 50% to start, 50% on delivery. Two rounds of changes included.
investment.ongoing: Payment-provider fees are paid by you.

alerts: Instagram and the competitor were not verified
questions_for_client: How many orders do you take per week today?

findings.note: Online ordering at 2,200 – 4,000; the knowledge says 3,000 – 5,000.
The total written is 2,200 – 4,000; the core items add up to 2,500 – 4,500.
